best_for: Online trading with options pricing that changes with quarterly activity.

checked_profile.summary: Online trading with options pricing that changes with quarterly activity.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Online stock and ETF trades
facts.text: $0 commissions on eligible online U.S.-listed stock and ETF trades. OTC securities, foreign transactions and broker-assisted orders have separate charges.

facts.label: Options contracts
facts.text: $0.65 per contract, or $0.50 for customers who execute at least 30 qualifying stock, ETF or options trades per quarter. Regulatory and exchange fees can apply.

facts.label: Mutual funds
facts.text: No-load, no-transaction-fee funds have $0 transaction fees. Fund expenses and any sales loads remain.

facts.label: Other costs
facts.text: Broker-assisted trades generally add $25. The standard online OTC stock commission is $6.95, reduced to $4.95 at the qualifying activity threshold.

questions: Which pricing plan and fee schedule apply to my account and intended trades?
What regulatory, exchange, fund or service fees are additional to the advertised commission?
